title: ÆTHER album Kaattu Thee: Fight swagger theme, take 2 extended (complete version)
story: Rudra walks slowly into the villain's den, calm and smiling, and the whole room knows the fight is already over.

brief.notes: Jithesh 13:35 on fight v2: 'We can use both but bit longer version. This feels like incomplete versions.' Take 2 kept exactly (inpainting upload), then a new second theme, a breakdown and a bigger final hook conditioned on its own sections, and its own ending kept. One take (owner rule).

chunks.text:
[Second theme]
{instrumental: the hook moves to brass and strings with a new counter-melody on the veena, heavier drums}
positive_styles: modern Tamil film mass hero fight theme, instrumental, continue the reference exactly: same key, same 92 BPM swaggering half-time groove, same sound and instruments

twangy retro electric guitar with tremolo, a cocky whistled hook, deep punchy brass stabs, dark growling distorted synth bass, gritty electronic sound design, big stomping drums with Indian thavil accents, a veena answering the hook
the same short menacing hook melody, clean cinematic stylish mix with space, not noisy
